name: Homestay Heaven
source:
A young man finds himself on a jet heading to another country. He will stay with a new family as exchange culture program... He hopes to get along with his new family...

[Edited from F95zone]
translation:
一名年轻人发现自己乘坐飞机前往另一个国家。他将留在一个新的家庭作为文化交流项目…他希望能和他的新家庭和睦相处…

[编辑自F95zone]
